svg.title: Allocate Startup Capital Before Expanding Acquisition
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate Startup Capital Before Expanding Acquisition; subtitle: Four buckets total $12,000 lean, $30,000 planning, or $50,000 expanded.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values encode the $30,000 planning stack. Each stage also supplies its lean and expanded allocations. The endpoints are startup funding envelopes, not annual operating expenses, revenue forecasts, or a substitute for receivables funding.; caption: Lean: $3,000 + $2,500 + $2,500 + $4,000 = $12,000. Planning: $9,000 + $7,500 + $6,000 + $7,500 = $30,000. Expanded: $15,000 + $12,000 + $10,000 + $13,000 = $50,000.; stages: label: Contract and operating design; value: $9,000 planning allocation; $3,000 lean and $15,000 expanded; numeric value: 9000.0; detail: Fund jurisdiction-specific service agreements, compensation structure assessment, record-access forms, insurance setup, and initial vendor diligence. Arizona ABS licensing is a separate scoped undertaking, not an assumed deliverable inside this allocation.; label: Secure intake and record stack; value: $7,500 planning allocation; $2,500 lean and $12,000 expanded; numeric value: 7500.0; detail: Configure restricted CRM roles, MFA, encrypted storage, audit exports, TrustedForm capture, and approved identity-verification integrations. Confirm contractual data handling before connecting an LLM to live records.; label: Controlled acquisition pilot; value: $6,000 planning allocation; $2,500 lean and $10,000 expanded; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Purchase a bounded campaign sample with daily spend limits and source-level loss reporting. Require documented contact authority, vendor credit terms, and counsel's current case criteria before increasing campaign exposure.; label: Retrieval and cash reserve; value: $7,500 planning allocation; $4,000 lean and $13,000 expanded; numeric value: 7500.0; detail: Reserve cash for initial provider charges, contractor timing, and disputed service credits. Even the expanded $13,000 bucket cannot absorb a delayed $58,750 Base monthly invoice; arrange staged billing or additional working capital before committing that delivery volume.

rect.title: label: Contract and operating design; numeric value: 9000.0; value: $9,000 planning allocation; $3,000 lean and $15,000 expanded; detail: Fund jurisdiction-specific service agreements, compensation structure assessment, record-access forms, insurance setup, and initial vendor diligence. Arizona ABS licensing is a separate scoped undertaking, not an assumed deliverable inside this allocation.

Confirm contractual data handling before connecting an LLM to live records.
